page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full-width title lines at top; a woodcut engraving in the centre; imprint lines below the engraving. No margins with text.

main_text.l: in Schola Tigurina, Historiae insectorum Libellus, qui est
fasciculo methodicè collectus & in lucem editus.
Cum gratia & priuilegio S. Caesarea Maiestatis ad decennium.

page.notes: Woodcut engraving in the centre of the page (decorative border with figures, a central scene with a putto and a tree); no text inside it. Long s rendered as s throughout. The lines in the title are reproduced as printed, with the printed hyphens at line ends.
